narr: An upper disturbance tracked from west to east across the area, resulting in a swath of showers and thunderstorms producing heavy rainfall. Over 3 inches of rainfall was measured at the Capital Airport in Springfield, which led to flash flooding of roads in the city.
ev: Several roads on the north and west side of Springfield were closed due to high water. A few vehicles stalled out in the water.
lsr: Several roads on the north and west side of Springfield have been closed due to high water. A few vehicles have been stranded in the water.
